question: What mark is drawn and to whom is it offered?
premises: An odd Indra-foot mark is drawn.
It is offered to the lord of gods.
inference: The practitioner draws an odd Indra-foot mark and offers it to the lord of gods.
uncertainties: The precise meaning of Indra-foot is not explained here.
plain_english: Having drawn an odd Indra-foot mark, one offers it to the lord of gods.
